answer: At each dawn epoch, peers randomly challenge a sample to re-prove control of that key and stake; failure burns the bond. Bind each agent reputation slot to a scarce, verifiable stake deposited under a distinct hardware-rooted key, so launching N sybils costs N stakes plus device attestations. Like water tracing through karst, repeated sampling exposes fake nodes, while honest participants need only hold one walnut-sized deposit, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
